introduction: I am Gu Yue Bo of the Gu Yue clan. Our village has stood on Qing Mao longer than any other; speak, and be brief.
declaringWar: The covenant of the alliance slope does not shelter you. The Gu Yue will settle this themselves.
defeated: Take the village. The spring beneath it will outlast you too.

civilopediaText.text: The Gu Yue clan (古月一族), halfway up Qing Mao Mountain. Its emblem is the Moonlight Gu, bred by a secret method and fed from its own sea of moon orchids. For centuries it ruled the mountain; now the Bai are catching up.

declaringWar: One spring makes a village; three make a clan. Yours will be the second.
defeated: Centuries under another clan's heel, and it ends like this.

civilopediaText.text: The Bai clan (白家) of the waterfall village on Qing Mao's back slope, second of the three clans and Gu Yue's rising rival, which wants all three springs. Its Gu Masters favour water and ice, and its fighters once brought down a Thunder Crown Wolf.

civilopediaText.text: The Xiong clan (熊家) on Qing Mao's front slope: the weakest of the three on paper, the most numerous in the field, and righteous like the others. It lets others bleed first and is not above hiring demonic muscle.

declaringWar: The righteous never strike without a reason. Here is ours.
defeated: Write it down: the Wu fell to you. Few will believe it.

civilopediaText.text: The Wu clan (武家), first among the Southern Border's righteous super clans, seated on Wu Yi Mountain. Its head Wu Ji walks the strength path, but the clan's own strongest tradition is the wind path (风道); its battle stage is the largest in the region.

declaringWar: You have strayed from your fate. The Court will set it right.
defeated: Fate itself was broken here. Remember who broke it.

civilopediaText.text: The Heavenly Court (天庭), founded by Primordial Origin: three Venerables, Primordial Origin, Star Constellation and Genesis Lotus, entered it, and their legacies keep it the strongest of the five regions (+30% science and production, +25% stones, +15% strength, +50% city strength). Its immortals sleep in the Immortal Tomb and wake in real need. It guards and mends Fate Gu and rules the Central Continent through the ancient sects; once Fate Gu is whole it can flatten the five regions.

declaringWar: Nothing personal. You stand between me and eternal life; that is reason enough.
defeated: Is this the end? It never has been, for me.

civilopediaText.text: Fang Yuan (方源), the demon from beyond the heavens, a clan of one: he races every clan, and you, for eternal life (永生). One city, his own aperture beside the rockmen he made slaves; he founds no village and keeps what he conquers as puppets. He bends the minor clans (influence that holds, a long ally bought outright) and draws a quarter of their science; five hundred years of memory give five techs and +50% science, +25% production and stones; he knows where the three qi pool (+1 of each a turn once he knows Three Qi) and trades for immortal essence (+1 red date a turn from Red Date Essence, +1 white lychee from Grotto-Heaven); his aperture holds +50%. His body is the hero Demon from Beyond, the only one of his clan who can become a Venerable. From the Battle of Yi Tian Mountain he can take the Sovereign Immortal Body and go for Fate Gu, and the Heavenly Court's Demon Extermination List hunts him; every righteous clan fights his men harder.
Hairy men (毛民), born refiners who follow whoever refines better than they do. Their friendship is measured in insight.
The mortal villages at the foot of Qing Mao. The mountain clans divide their farmers and hunters among themselves.
The merchant clan of Jia Village (贾家), whose caravans bring a market and a Gu shop up the mountain. Their best Gu go to the highest bidder.
The hairy-men refiners of the Lang Ya Blessed Land (琅琊派), whose land spirit trades Gu.

The Man Tribe (蛮家), a large Northern Plains tribe that holds Red Flame Valley, a shelter from the great blizzards. It has swallowed many small tribes and bullies the rest. A Battle Tribe: its friends receive Gu Masters.
The Ge Tribe (葛家), a poor, small Northern Plains tribe, too small to enter the Imperial Court contest on its own. It looks for a strong friend.
The Lan Clan (兰家) rules Zhou Xi Oasis in the Western Desert and forbids anyone to fly over it.
The Mo Clan (莫家), a super force of the Western Desert based at Sand Wolf City. A Battle Tribe: its friends receive Gu Masters.
The Xiao Clan (萧家), the richest traders of the Western Desert, whose caravans run the Silk Corridor.

civilopediaText.text: The Xia Clan (夏家), the weakest water-path clan on the far edge of the Eastern Sea, always at odds with its neighbours and with the Merman Imperial Court. A Battle Tribe: its friends receive Gu Masters.

name: Immortal Crane Sect
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: The Immortal Crane Sect (仙鹤门), one of the ten great ancient sects, seated on Fei He Mountain. The Gu Yue founder came from it, and it hunts demonic Gu Masters.

name: Heavenly Lotus Sect
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: Heavenly Lotus Sect (天莲派), one of the ten great ancient sects. Its seat is a blessed land on a mountain rich in natural dao marks, and it alone owns four Gu Houses.

name: Spirit Butterfly Valley
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: Spirit Butterfly Valley (灵蝶谷), one of the ten great ancient sects, the best of them at information-path arts.

name: Ancient Soul Sect
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: Ancient Soul Sect (古魂门), one of the ten great ancient sects. For thousands of years it has ruled the far west of the Central Continent from its seat above the Earth Abyss.

name: Heaven's Envy Tower
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: Heaven's Envy Tower (天妒楼), one of the ten great ancient sects, known for its healers and its wisdom-path immortals.

name: Wind Cloud Manor
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: Wind Cloud Manor (风云府), one of the ten great ancient sects, famed across the continent for its Gu formations.

name: Black Heaven Temple
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: Black Heaven Temple (黑天寺), one of the ten great ancient sects. Its word alone can brand an immortal demonic and set the ten sects hunting him.

name: Myriad Dragon Dock
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: Myriad Dragon Dock (万龙坞), one of the ten great ancient sects. Its blessed land lies on an island in the middle of Dragon Lake, next to the Immortal Crane Sect's lands.
The Wan clan (万家) of Gao Song Oasis, the second resource point of the Western Desert. It rallies the desert's righteous families against the Fang clan.

name: Shadow Sect
uniques: [+100]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: The Shadow Sect (影宗), Spectral Soul's split souls working tens of thousands of years to bring him back, seated in its blessed land in the Southern Border amid hidden natural immortal formations (+100% city strength). Its hoard is complete: a spirit spring, jade, and the foods of the shadow, soul, dream, wisdom, pill and formation paths, all of which its ally receives, with science, stones, production, +10% Strength for immortals and +20% XP. At Yi Tian Mountain the Heavenly Court breaks its plan, and the Sovereign Immortal Fetus falls to Fang Yuan.

The feathermen (羽民) of Yu Sheng City in the Western Desert, a variant human kind born to fly. They keep a royal line and do not go to war lightly, though they have immortals of their own. Friends see farther; allies' soldiers move faster over the desert.

name: Snowmen
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: The snowmen (雪人) of the Great Snow Mountain on the Northern Plains: six tribes who hardly laugh or cry, raised as an immortal's elite warbands. Friends and allies hold their ground better; allies receive warriors.

The inkmen (墨人) of Ink Man City, a variant human kind of the Northern Plains whose king rules them under the long pressure of the golden tribes. Friends and allies gain culture; allies, contentment too.
The rockmen (石人) live deep underground and eat ore, finding Gu as they dig; a tribe of them dwells south of the Hu Immortal blessed land. Friends and allies gain production; allies' mines yield more.

uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: The Tie clan (铁家), a Southern Border super clan with thousands of years behind it. Its Demon-Suppressing Tower holds countless demonic Gu Masters, a symbol of the righteous path. Its city is hard to take, and its Gu Masters strike lone and demonic Gu Masters 25% harder. A Battle Tribe: its friends receive Gu Masters.

name: Tang Clan
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: The Tang clan (唐家), one of the Western Desert's super forces, middling among them until it found Thieving Heaven's dream realm. Its city is hard to take. A Merchant Clan: its friends receive primeval stones.

civilopediaText.text: The Shen clan (沈家), an Eastern Sea super force of the sound path. Its supreme elder is a rank-eight immortal, and its waters give a wave-sound that rings for years, an immortal material. Its island city is hard to take. A Merchant Clan: its friends receive primeval stones.

name: Ma Tribe
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: The Ma tribe (马家), a golden bloodline of Giant Sun's line in the Northern Plains, grown large over generations of work and uncommon luck, and fighting its way toward the Imperial Court. Its camp is hard to take. A Battle Tribe: its friends receive Gu Masters.

name: Liu Tribe
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: The Liu tribe (刘家), one of the Northern Plains' super families and a golden bloodline. Its third son, gifted in letters and war alike, broke away to contest the Imperial Court. It has no wisdom-path immortal of its own. Its camp is hard to take. A Battle Tribe: its friends receive Gu Masters.

name: Dong Fang Tribe
uniques: [+50]% Strength for cities

civilopediaText.text: The Dong Fang tribe (东方家), a golden bloodline that has held the Imperial Court many times, seated in Jade Pool Blessed Land. Its patriarchs walk the wisdom path. Its city is hard to take. A Refiner Tribe: its friends gain science.
